##### Project general facts

Tivanno Residence by AYS Developers is a refined waterfront residential building with sea and marina views, combining contemporary design with branded finishes and high-end technology. The building rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to eight residential floors and a roof. The collection offers one- and two-bedroom apartments, exclusive three-bedroom duplexes and four-bedroom residences, many with balconies featuring built-in private jacuzzis and provisions for motorised curtains for added comfort.

Residents enjoy a rooftop saltwater infinity pool overlooking the sea and the marina, a children's pool, an advanced fitness centre and an infrared sauna for wellness and relaxation. A cinema room, a children's playroom, a games room and a business lounge add variety, while a lobby with round-the-clock concierge, electric vehicle parking and smart access create a seamless, hotel-inspired living experience for residents and their guests throughout the year.

Interiors feature branded fixtures from renowned international names, including Scavolini kitchens and wardrobes, Dornbracht sanitary fittings, Bertolotto doors, Ceracasa tiles and Villeroy and Boch, together with frameless internal doors and a full Alexa smart home system. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and premium appliances, while the four-bedroom residences come fully furnished, offering a complete and sophisticated living space.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront master community of five man-made islands off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods, resorts, marinas and long stretches of public beach. Landscaped promenades, parks and cycling paths run along the shoreline, while hotels, beach clubs and waterfront dining venues give the islands a relaxed resort character close to the historic heart of the city.

The Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with Deira, Bur Dubai and the city centre. Dubai Islands Beach, the Waterfront Market and the Gold Souk are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for premium waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
